description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Steiner
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Charge! (0~2), removed after using Charge! two times

description.name: Charge! Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Charge! level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Steiner]

description.name: Charge! Level
description.text: Keeps track of Charge! level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Steiner]
